findings.claim: C4 enforcement law: external vendor numbers (Sarvam bench cells, Bodhan, PaddleOCR-VL) get transfer obituaries and are DEAD-for-decisions unless re-measured on own manifest with same gates.

Sarvam Vision 2.1 overall 87.39 (6,909 samples = 6,609 x 22 langs + 300 EN) is block-level accuracy in vendor layout-parser harness; does not transfer to our CER/WER tiers; 'beat 87.39' directional only.
findings.numbers: 87.39; 6,909 samples; revive only on n=1,227 manifest SEED=20260926

findings.claim: Santali weak cell: Sarvam 53.91 (global bench minimum), Bodhan 68.30 on same cell (14.4-pt gap) - vendor slice script mix (Ol Chiki/Bengali) undisclosed; our sat cell n=20, 100% sarvam_fill.

Kashmiri 54.82 (prior gen 55.93 = flat across generations; Urdu 91.21 / Sindhi 91.44 strong on same bench) indicates Nastaliq-Kashmiri-specific failure; our ks cell is PDF-tier VERIFY-FIRST trust 45.0, barred from W6 (D4).

OldScan 55.3 (Sarvam 2.1) is the field-wide worst column for every model (olmOCR-bench framing R1:72; Surya old_scan 42.8 R6:141); degradation mix differs from our 200-dpi renders so no vendor number transfers; decisions use own old-scan slice + Otsu-baseline deltas (R4).

Odia: Sarvam 80.01, Gemini 3.6 Flash 81.01, Bodhan 75.45 - three-way race within ~5 pts with no CIs; our or-cell is PDF-tier + 19 fill with script-ratio gate; judged winnable by wrap/ensemble only via paired on-manifest numbers.
Bodhan overall 84.94 vs Sarvam 87.39, Gemini 79.35, GCV 71.76 on Indic OCR Bench; vendor-vs-vendor means are competition intel only, never a W6 feasible-set input.

Devanagari/Arabic; Apache-2.0) scores 96.33% OmniDocBench v1.6 (CPT +0.69/SFT +0.63/RL +0.08 from 94.93; Real5 93.19); EN/CJK-heavy, no Ol Chiki/Nastaliq/Mayek claim; model = P2 (GPU+approval), method (Real5 axes, CPT->SFT->RL) alive.
Real5-OmniDocBench five distortion axes (scan/skew/warp/screen-photo/illumination) proposed as template for our missing old-scan stratification slice (~100 hand-tagged pages, section 6.8).
PP-OCRv6 (Jun 2026): PPLCNetV4, 1.5M-34.5M tiers, +4.6% det/+5.1% rec, 50 langs Latin+CJK only; no Indic claim -> context only.

Our probe rapidocr CER 0.6692 (n=1,227 scored; 343 missing, 15 loop-failures, 347 CER-100 rows) vs valid-samples CER 0.5417; raw-vs-normalized delta 0.0015 (0.6707 vs 0.6692); bare scalar citation is 'forgery-adjacent'.
Probe tesseract_indic CER 0.4870 (bilingual 0.4853; valid-only 0.4199; 102 CER-100 rows); timeouts 300s (bn_d014 ~78s, hi_d066 ~82s) are part of the number; tesseract ~122% CER on ornate EN scans.
Probe doctr CER 0.8691 (valid-only 0.8638, 47 CER-100 rows) - honestly bad on Indic; doctr ~42% on EN sanity column; claim only 'scored 0.869 on our manifest', not 'doctr bad at OCR'.
Probe anuvaad_tesseract CER 0.7114 pooled vs 0.3162 valid-only on 503 valid of 1,227 (672 CER-100 rows): must be reported as coverage + conditional CER pair, never scalar.

Probe sarvam_vision subset CER 0.2400 is n=54 (3/lang x 18 langs, credit cap; valid 0.2185 n=48), no EN column; cannot be compared with 0.487 at n=1,227; Sarvam is benchmark target not routable component (D2).

Estimator law (campaign 9.3): Wilson 95% intervals on every per-language CER; McNemar exact on paired same-item engine comparisons; coverage + conditional CER for abstention; n<50 cells no-winner (sat n=20; sarvam-subset 3/lang).
Scorer integrity 6.5 gates: empty pred = CER 1.0 counted, uncapped per-row CER with cer_100_count, single denominator, space-forgery removed; to be TDD-gated and asserted by a pre-report hook.
EN sanity column: 30 gold EN pairs (same gates, seed 20260926) per engine; CER>~5 on clean renders = broken harness; permanent gate before any weak-cell claim; tesseract ~122%, doctr ~42%.

Tier-split falsification 6.2: pair-GT / pdf-GT / fill-GT scored independently (no blended CER across tiers); this split is what barred ne (trust 26.6) and flagged ks/mr/gu/ur VERIFY-FIRST - judged highest-ROI scoring decision.

Two-stage GT gate: gt_forensics triage (control chars, glyph breakage, script ratios) then ~2h human verification on 158 fill + ~77 PDF sample; >20% fail = barred; D4 holds ks/mni/ur/sat/mr + ne-pdf barred from W6; sole exception micro-repair of 5-10 curated sat/ks pages (W5).
Control-char GT corruption example ne_o037 (PDF-layer extractor corruption) - PDF-extracted GT is a leakage/mirroring risk; MAX_CTRL_CHARS=3 gate exists.

Training guard: machine GT never trains; RLVR reward only on human-verified gold; synthesis allowed for harness self-test fixtures only, never probe GT or W6 training (DeepEval-generate contradiction C4-078).
Raw-vs-normalized CER ablation (0.6707 vs 0.6692, delta 0.0015) gates the RLVR scorer choice.

Sequential-engine rule 5: one heavy engine at a time; measured runtimes paddle ~2h/15GB peak RSS (13.6s/page), surya ~1h (47.9s), indicphotoocr ~12h (299.6s); worst-case scans 4250x6500; parallel-engine violation 2026-09-26.
